campaign_contract.checkpoint_boundary: create-only fixed-range shard receipts plus one evaluation reservation; immutable only after their hashes are committed to protected Git history
campaign_contract.writer_model: one create-only reservation per evaluation ID plus one create-only local writer lock per campaign ID; concurrent acquisition under either the same or a second campaign ID fails before shard evaluation
campaign_contract.resume_rule: Acquire the first missing fixed shard. Existing valid receipts are idempotent checkpoints; a conflicting receipt is retained as an invariant error.
campaign_contract.deduplication: Typed identity is the unique ordinal in the frozen Cartesian universe. Exact duplicate semantic axis definitions fail preflight. Broader semantic equivalence remains a review obligation.
campaign_contract.coverage_proof: Gap-free non-overlapping power-of-two shard ranges plus composable RFC6962 range frontiers must reconstruct the canonical frozen-space root.
campaign_contract.larger_space_rule: A larger campaign requires a new evidence-bounded grammar and a new universe ID. A new evidence snapshot creates a new evaluation ID, not new universe coverage.
campaign_contract.error_retention: Only post-preflight operational failures belong here. Scientific support or refutation belongs in typed desk decisions or experiment outcomes.

retention_contract.pre_anchor_trust_boundary: Before a Git commit anchors the claim, receipts and errors are crash-resumable and tamper-evident while present, but a privileged local actor can delete them. No stronger durability is claimed.
retention_contract.full_cell_identity: canonical space instance root plus mixed-radix ordinal
retention_contract.physical_evaluation_accounting: Successful retained receipt evaluations are exact. Failed attempts are retained as operational error events because a crash may make their partial cell count unknowable.
retention_contract.bounded_diagnostics: aggregate masks, type counts, shard roots, endpoint leaf hashes, and operational errors

epistemic_contract.cold_cell: A typed cell failed a deterministic structural gate. It is not a tested mathematical hypothesis.
epistemic_contract.warm_cell: A typed cell survived structural gates but still lacks an assured mechanism and independent review.
